quest.title: Custodian of Clouds
quest.description: Following Moon Carver's instructions, you arrive at Mt. Aocang in order to seek out Cloud Retainer.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x12250, Adventurer's Experience x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, who put this table here? They've even set it ready for dinner, there's a wine jug and everything...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, they even have the guests' names carved into the seats! "Here sits Retainer..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Here sits Guizhong..." "Here sits Rex..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe "Rex" is short for "Rex Lapis"? But Paimon has no idea about "Guizhong."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As for "Retainer," hmm... That's it! When Moon Carver was going through the names of his adepti buddies, he said there was one called "Cloud Retainer."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, this must be where Cloud Retainer and the other adepti have their dinner parties!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, how about we cook up some extra-special dishes for the adepti? We're sure to get Cloud Retainer's attention that way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... What do adepti even eat, anyway? Paimon has no idea...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, people must make offerings here all the time. Guess all we can do is look around the area for any leftovers, maybe that'll give us some ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, do you think maybe it's at all possible that the adepti might like to try some... Sticky Honey Roast?

talks.objective: Look for traces of food offerings

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Someone has definitely cooked here before. D'you think they were making an offering?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like they didn't use all the ingredients. Let's see here... we got some Snapdragon, some Lotus Heads, some Tofu... Whatever they were cooking, it sounds complicated!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look over there... They left some notes, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, it's a doozy! Paimon's not surprised they had to write it all down, it's a lot to remember... We should read it carefully.

talks.objective: Look for traces of food offerings

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... The ground is covered in flour. Tsk... What a messy chef...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, seems there's meat in this pot, but Paimon can't tell which kind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think whoever cooked this made it as an offering to the adepti?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Paimon can't quite imagine an offering made of flour and meat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Our messy chef dropped a piece of paper on the floor... Ew, and there's a huge footprint on it too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But footprint aside, maybe it has something to do with this mystery dish?

talks.objective: Look for traces of food offerings

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's very clean here. Whoever cooked here last obviously likes to keep things neat and tidy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon bets they were making an offering to the adepti...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we got us some Matsutake and some Raw Meat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And what do you know, the recipe is right here. This chef was a super organized person...

talks.objective: Offer the Delicious Matsutake Meat Rolls
Offer up food to Cloud Retainer

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One is most impressed. The path that leads through this abode defies those of ordinary abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The one before you is the adeptus, Cloud Retainer. Now, speak of the matter which brings you here.

choices.text: Did you build this whole place?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: You surmise correctly. This place did oneself build, as did one design the mechanisms within.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: In fact, even Guizhong and Rex Lapis themselves found one's technological accomplishments to be worthy of commendation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This place is huge! And there are so many mechanisms... Do you really have this whole place to yourself?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's it even for? Did you build it as your private mechanism workshop or something?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's just like the stories say. The adepti leave the human world, find somewhere to go be a hermit, and then they research and invent all these amazing things...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: One is simply not partial to the tedium of social interaction, and wished to find some peace and quiet.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Find it one did... Shortly after which, you arrived bearing your Sigil of Permission...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: But enough! State the matter which brings you here, at once! You have disturbed the tranquility of this place for long enough.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Rex Lapis... Assassinated!?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: How can this be!? Such a heinous crime... Who would dare?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The notion is so preposterous as to be unbelievable... one shall have to verify the truth of the matter independently...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...Perhaps one shall quash Liyue first, then convene with the other adepti—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Excuse me!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what!? Did you just say "squash Liyue Harbor"? Are you seriously gonna wipe out the whole city?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Only a response of sufficient magnitude can negate the possibility of further incidents.

choices.text: But the adepti are sworn to protect the city...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: It is as you say. We have protected Liyue Harbor under the leadership of Rex Lapis for 37 centuries. But in the face of this coup by nefarious actors... exceptional measures must be taken.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: It is precisely because one does not wish to see further suffering that exceptional measures are deemed necessary at this exceptional time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yikes! Quick, you gotta think of something! She wants to squash Liyue flat, and it doesn't seem like she's bluffing!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You accepted our offering, that makes this a contract.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly what Paimon was gonna say! We made all that delicious food, and gave every last bit of it to you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We were hoping you might help Liyue out... not wipe Liyue out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Or at least let's... y'know, discuss it first? Can't hurt for you to get a second opinion.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: "Contract..." A cruel irony that you should appeal to the notion after the merciless murder of the God of Contracts himself.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: The people of Liyue seem quite content to dispense with their contracts. They are quite adept at taking that which is composed of black and white, and turning it gray...

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Nevertheless... Since you come here in the name of contracts, far be it from one to abandon one's own contractual obligations.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Least of all when you come bearing a Sigil of Permission... *sigh* Rex Lapis infused these sigils with adeptal power when he first cast them. That power once aided humans in battle.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Most of the sigil's power has long since worn off... It is but a keepsake now.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: This keepsake cannot be taken as proof of your trustworthiness. One must investigate the claims that you make independently.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: This, no doubt, is Moon Carver's very reason for summoning us.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Your audience with the adeptus before you is now concluded. Leave at once, and disturb me no further.

choices.text: Aren't you supposed to protect the people there?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: It is as you say. But if Rex Lapis has indeed been murdered, then Liyue is in great peril. To delay in quashing the threat is to invite further disaster.

choices.text: Did you design all those mechanisms?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: You surmise correctly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you get if you cross Matsutake and Raw Meat? Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's so curious, what kind of dish uses only flour and meat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What would you call a dish that's made from Snapdragon, Lotus Heads, and Tofu? Hmm...
